title: Argentinian Parrillada Tofu
description: A delicious and healthy twist on the classic Argentinian Parrillada, featuring marinated tofu instead of meat.

ingredients.name: Roasted vegetables
ingredients.notes: such as bell peppers, onions, and mushrooms

instructions: 2. In a small bowl, mix together soy sauce and chimichurri sauce.
3. Cut tofu into 1-inch cubes and place in a separate bowl.
4. Pour soy sauce mixture over tofu and toss to coat.
5. Add parrillada seasoning, garlic, and parsley to the tofu mixture and toss again.
6. Grill tofu for 3-4 minutes per side, or until golden brown.
7. Meanwhile, slice Argentinian bread into 1-inch thick slices.
8. Grill bread for 1-2 minutes per side, or until lightly toasted.
9. Serve tofu on top of grilled bread, with roasted vegetables on the side.
